# Aboutness Mode

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:AboutnessMode`](gmeow-AboutnessMode.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/AboutnessMode>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/kernel`](../../slices/kernel.md)

The rhetorical relation between an information carrier and its subject matter — whether the carrier describes the subject (mention: reporting, quoting, depicting, analyzing) or enacts it (use: performing, demanding, exemplifying, embodying). A value vocabulary of individuals (never subclasses). Orthogonal to granularity, determinacy, sensitivity, confidence, and standpoint modality ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)): a carrier may describe one subject while enacting another, and distinct vantages may classify the same carrier differently through the statement layer. The distinction every rubric, citation, and evidence assessment eventually needs: text ABOUT deception is not text THAT deceives.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:AboutnessMode`](gmeow-AboutnessMode.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
